cd /private/tmp/vista-task002-local-3x3-20260822-07/formal-task002-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-07-pd-vista-replicate-01/workspace/DATA/products && python3 << 'EOF'
import json

with open('PersonalizeForce.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Look at all meeting transcripts
print("=== Meeting transcripts ===")
for m in data['meeting_transcripts']:
    print(f"--- {m.get('id')} date={m.get('date')} type={m.get('document_type')} ---")
    print(f"Participants: {m.get('participants')}")
    # Check first 500 chars of transcript
    transcript = m.get('transcript', '')
    if 'competitor' in transcript.lower() or 'personaai' in transcript.lower() or 'smartsuggest' in transcript.lower() or 'tailorai' in transcript.lower():
        print(f"  *** Contains competitor mentions ***")
        # Print relevant sections
        for line in transcript.split('\n'):
            if any(k in line.lower() for k in ['competitor', 'personaai', 'smartsuggest', 'tailorai']):
                print(f"  > {line[:300]}")
    print()
EOF
